title: repro.yml
description: A repository's policy for Repro: the invariants a change must keep, what a claim needs, and how much may go unchecked. Read from the base ref (ARCHITECTURE §12).

invariants.description: Each item names one invariant, with its options; at most one item per invariant.

require_explicit.description: A change with no extractable claim is UNVERIFIABLE.

max_uncovered_changed_symbols.description: Above this fraction of changed symbols no selected test reaches, the change is UNVERIFIABLE.

public_api_stable.description: No breaking change to the public API (true, or the objects allowed to change).

no_new_dependencies.description: No dependency added (true, or the packages allowed).

no_network.description: Head's tests attempt no network access.

perf_budget.description: No selected test slower than base by more than this fraction.

forbidden_paths.description: Paths the change must not touch: glob patterns relative to the repository root, with / (* within a segment, ** across segments, ? one character); a pattern that matches a directory forbids everything under it.
